Just cut myself (by accident). It seems pretty deep. At what point should I go get stitches?

Keep applying pressure and wait for the bleeding to stop. If it still bleeds when you let go after an hour of applying pressure you need stitches.

You can get away with pretty deep cuts as long as you haven't cut any veins. Obviously infection is very likely, so you need Betadine and clean dressings.

Rinse well, apply a dab of anti-biotic gel and add bandage. Don't flex the finger. Does the bleeding slow and stop? If it does, you're okay. You may need stitches (or skin staples) when a bandage and slight pressure won't stop the flow. Butterfly bandages work well to match the edges of a cut together, but avoid them if you can't cover the whole thing with some gauze. I'm a firm believer in protecting wounds.

If the cut is real deep you'll be able to tell a bandage won't work right off the bat. It's those "maybes" you need to be careful with. I've had a few where it would stop bleeding for a little bit, but physical activity that pumped up my heart rate started the flow all over again.
